sentences.text: NAFR  HIGH COURT OF CHHATTISGARH, BILASPUR  CONT No. 882 of 2019

Ritesh Kumar Agrawal S/o Shri Natwar Lal Agrawal, Aged About 34  Years R/o Baradwar, Tahsil Sakti, District - Janjgir - Champa (C.G.) ---
 Petitioner
Versus  1 - Bajrang Dubey, Land Acquisition Officer -Cum Sub Divisional Officer  (Revenue), Champa, District Janjgir - Champa (C.G.)
2 - R. P. Yadav Executive Engineer P.W.D. N.H. Division Bilaspur (C.G.)

---- Respondents For the Petitioner : Mr. Tapan Kumar Chandra, Advocate For the respondents : Mr. Gagan Tiwari,
Advocate.

Hon'ble Shri Justice Goutam Bhaduri, Judge Order on Board (16.01.2024)
1) The present contempt has been filed for the reason that an award was passed on 30.07.2016 but compensation has not been released.

Thereafter the reference was made to the Arbitrator wherein the arbitrator has passed the award on 15.11.2017 and the amount was enhanced.
2) Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the said amount has not been paid.
3) In reply, respondents would submit that the amount of initial award has been paid and as per the instructions, the petitioners have received the amount.

However, if the amount is enhanced by the Arbitrator that would also be termed as decree as per Section 17 subsection (2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
4) Perused sub-section (2) of section 17 of the Act, 2013 which purports that every such award shall be deemed to have been a decree, therefore, if the compensation has been enhanced on a reference,
it would also amount to a decree, for which, the petitioner can avail the remedy by recovery mode by execution proceeding as available to him under the law.
5) In view of the said fact, no deliberate disobedience of the order is made out.
Accordingly, this contempt petition is dismissed.
Rule issued against the respondent is discharged.
